intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with TANCET. This page compares recorded fees and 2023 placements from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
Kumaraguru College of Technology vs KV Institute of Management and Information Studies should be read with the table names, not the short 'Kv Information' label in the title.

sections.heading: Kumaraguru College of Technology vs KV Institute for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Kumaraguru if you want an engineering-college MBA at the recorded year tuition of ₹35,000, with a 2023 record of ₹6 lakh average and ₹12 lakh highest, and a TANCET route.
Choose KV Institute if you want a specialist management campus with named MBA streams, after you budget for recorded other charges of ₹95,000 and ₹1 lakh on top of ₹35,000 tuition.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Kumaraguru we hold ₹35,000 as MBA tuition for one year. That is a year figure, not a confirmed two-year official total, and it may reflect a government-quota circular. Confirm the current notice.
For KV Institute we also hold ₹35,000 as tuition for one year, but the same rows include other charges of ₹95,000 and ₹1 lakh. Do not treat ₹35,000 as the full recorded cost on that side.
Confirm both official notices on kct.ac.in and kvimis.co.in before you compare totals.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Kumaraguru has a 2023 MBA row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹12 lakh highest. KV Institute has a 2023 MBA Finance row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest.
These are historical records, not promises. KV Institute's finance row should not be stretched to every listed specialisation without a later official report.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both are listed with TANCET. KV Institute is also listed with CAT. Follow the official Tamil Nadu counselling process and each institute's brochure.
KV Institute has a Times rank of 84 in 2024 on our records. Kumaraguru has no MBA rank row here. The Times figure is not a NIRF rank.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private institutes in Coimbatore, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
Kumaraguru is an engineering college with a listed MBA. KV Institute is a management and information-studies campus with several named MBA streams.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Kumaraguru if the 2023 recorded average of ₹6 lakh and the recorded ₹35,000 year tuition, once confirmed officially, fit your plan.
Pick KV Institute if a specialist MBA campus and the CAT or TANCET route fit you, after you budget the recorded other charges as well as tuition.
Do not compare the two sides on ₹35,000 tuition alone, because KV Institute has additional recorded heads.

faqs.question: Are the MBA fees the same at Kumaraguru and KV Institute?
faqs.answer: Both have recorded year tuition of ₹35,000, but KV Institute also has other charges of ₹95,000 and ₹1 lakh on the same rows. Confirm both official notices before you compare totals.

faqs.question: How do 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: Kumaraguru has a 2023 MBA row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹12 lakh highest. KV Institute has a 2023 finance row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest. These are historical figures.

faqs.question: Which exams do these MBA programmes accept?
faqs.answer: Both are listed with TANCET. KV Institute is also listed with CAT. Follow the official counselling process and the institute brochures.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Coimbatore?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, as private institutes.

faqs.question: What does the short title 'Kv Information' refer to?
faqs.answer: It is a shortened label. The college in the table is KV Institute of Management and Information Studies. Use that name when you read fees and placements.

faqs.question: Does KV Institute have a rank on this page?
faqs.answer: Yes. We hold a Times rank of 84 in 2024. Kumaraguru has no MBA rank row here. The Times figure is not a NIRF rank.
